about: Interface translations for kn (Tagalog / Filipino). The only course this interface serves is tl-ko (Korean for Tagalog speakers), so "Korean", "Hangul" and "romanization" keys are translated literally for Korean, and "English" keys literally (Ingles). Fill every "t" (leave the other fields: they are reference only). Exact keys: the English UI string -> your text. Patterns: the template -> your text with {1}..{k} standing for the slots in template order (reorder freely; every slot must appear). Slot types: n = integer count; f = decimal number; s = short text (lazy match), e.g. a deck or lesson name; x = free text (greedy match); e = e-mail address; d = text without "·", e.g. a deck name inside a "·"-separated line. Follow docs/profiles/tl-ko.md (register, glossary) and tools/i18n/tl/NOTES.md (loanwords, tab names, open doubts). Then: python3 tools/i18n/gen.py kn && node tools/i18n/validate.js kn
